units.source_text: 夕雾看中了惟光的女儿，常想偷偷地走近她身旁去。

en.t: Yugiri had taken a liking to Koremitsu's daughter and often wished to steal quietly to her side.

units.source_text: 然而那女子的神态凛不可犯，不得接近。

en.t: Yet the young woman's manner was so dignified and unapproachable that he could not get near her.

units.source_text: 孩子家胆怯怕羞，也只有独自叹息而已。

en.t: Being still young, timid, and shy, he could only sigh to himself.

units.source_text: 他想：“这女子的相貌十分称我的心。

en.t: He thought, "This young woman's looks are very much to my taste.

units.source_text: 云居雁既然与我缘悭，为慰情之计，且去结识这个女子吧。”

en.t: Since Kumoinokari and I are ill-fated in love, I will try to comfort myself by becoming acquainted with this young woman."
